decks.notes: This deck focuses on an aggressive combo strategy, utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Colossus Hammer to quickly equip powerful artifacts onto creatures and deal massive amounts of damage in a single turn. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Esper Sentinel and Giver of Runes to protect the combo pieces and control the opponent's plays. The pay-off card, Kaldra Compleat, can quickly close out games once the combo is assembled. The deck aims to win quickly and decisively through explosive plays and efficient combos.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Territorial Kavu, Wild Nacatl, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to pressure the opponent early on. Utilizing a mix of efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial, along with powerful pump spells like Tribal Flames, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. By including Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, the deck gains access to additional mana acceleration and a backup plan for late-game explosiveness. The mana base is well-optimized to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

The deck aims to quickly assemble a board full of creatures by leveraging the Cascade mechanic with cards like Violent Outburst and Bloodbraid Elf. Once the board is set up, Glimpse of Tomorrow is used to shuffle the creatures into the library and reveal cards until another permanent is revealed, potentially creating a powerful board state. Shardless Agent and Risen Reef help dig deeper into the library for combo pieces, while Endurance provides disruption against opposing strategies. Overall, the deck focuses on explosive plays and unexpected combos to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and fast creatures. The deck aims to utilize cards like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Eidolon of the Great Revel to apply pressure early in the game, while also using creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear to continue the assault. The inclusion of efficient dual lands and flexible spells like Boros Charm and Atarka's Command allow for versatility and consistent damage output, ultimately aiming to defeat the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

This aggro deck focuses on playing efficient creatures and utilizing powerful multi-colored spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By including Jegantha as a companion, the deck gains access to additional mana while maintaining a streamlined game plan. With a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan and Tarmogoyf, along with versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of Leyline Binding also helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect key creatures.

This deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and powerful cascade spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, players can cascade into powerful threats like Crashing Footfalls. The deck is focused on getting creatures on the board quickly and efficiently, while also disrupting opponents with counter spells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy and ensure smooth cascades. Overall, this deck seeks to outpace opponents and dominate the game with explosive plays.

The deck focuses on using cards with the Cascade mechanic to quickly deploy threats onto the battlefield while also disrupting opponent's game plan with counterspells. By cascading into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and combining them with aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and finish the game quickly. The deck also includes tempo plays like Brazen Borrower and removal options like Dead / Gone to control the board and maintain pressure. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with key cards that disrupt the opponent's strategy, such as Grief and Thoughtseize. It also includes powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to pressure the opponent. The use of cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provides additional value and card advantage. Feign Death serves as a combat trick to protect your creatures or generate additional value. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats, while also utilizing cards like Blood Moon to disrupt opposing mana bases.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer combo using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to equip it onto a creature like Ornithopter or Memnite for a fast, powerful attack. The deck is focused on quickly getting out equipment and utilizing cards like Sigarda's Aid to avoid paying equip costs. The inclusion of Urza's Saga helps to search for key artifacts like Colossus Hammer, while Giver of Runes and Shadowspear provide protection and additional utility. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a powerful and fast combo strategy.

The main concept of this Merfolk aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with powerful Merfolk creatures like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, supported by cards like Merfolk Trickster and Tide Shaper for tempo advantage. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation help control the game while protecting the Merfolk creatures. Aether Vial allows for quick creature deployment, and lands like Cavern of Souls provide mana fixing and protection against counterspells. With a focus on aggression and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents in a fast-paced Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly getting artifact creatures onto the battlefield and equipping them with powerful equipment like Cranial Plating and Shadowspear to deal large amounts of damage early in the game. The deck also includes Urza's Saga and Thought Monitor to generate card advantage and maintain tempo. With a low mana curve and a strong emphasis on synergy between artifacts, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and efficient card draw.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing strong creatures with disruptive abilities like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, along with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to control the board while applying pressure to the opponent. The deck also includes hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, as well as additional card advantage engines such as Seasoned Pyromancer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The inclusion of Feign Death and Undying Malice allows for graveyard recursion and additional creature value, making this deck a versatile and aggressive contender in the Modern format.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while controlling the board with removal spells and counterspells. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, backed up by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also has ways to filter through the deck and find the necessary cards with tools like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed to push the aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with permission spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while also generating card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive strategy, allowing for consistent casting of spells and maintaining tempo throughout the game.
